reviews.text: I am extremely pleased with my experience with Top Notch Tree. They removed a large, overgrown willow tree. Javan provided an excellent quote. The crew executed tree removal, stump grinding & complete clean-up in 30 minutes.
reviews.author: Jackie H.

reviews.text: They did a trim of a couple trees on my property. The work was good, they cleaned up, didn't damage anything. We quoted a few services, and they were all pretty close in price. What set them apart in my mind was the communication.
reviews.author: Christopher C.

reviews.text: I very much appreciated Rhett's very quick response to my initial phone call inquiring about getting our tree removed & also how quickly he & his crew were actually able to come & do the job.
reviews.author: Michelle L.
